Each value is set, in rising precedence, by its default, by the YAML file named by
--config-file=PATH or MEDIATED_MAILBOX_CONFIG_FILE, by its environment variable and
by its flag. A value other than a string is written as YAML, so a list is [a, b].
A default that is an empty string or holds a newline is shown quoted, a newline as \n.

scanner.triggers.<key>
  environment: MEDIATED_MAILBOX_SCANNER__TRIGGERS__<KEY>
  flag: --scanner.triggers.<key>=VALUE

scanner.link_words
  environment: MEDIATED_MAILBOX_SCANNER__LINK_WORDS
  flag: --scanner.link_words=VALUE
  default: [verify]

scanner.threshold
  environment: MEDIATED_MAILBOX_SCANNER__THRESHOLD
  flag: --scanner.threshold=VALUE
  default: 0.5

server.listen
  environment: MEDIATED_MAILBOX_SERVER__LISTEN
  flag: --server.listen=VALUE
  required

server.timeout
  environment: MEDIATED_MAILBOX_SERVER__TIMEOUT
  flag: --server.timeout=VALUE
  default: 5s

server.workers
  environment: MEDIATED_MAILBOX_SERVER__WORKERS
  flag: --server.workers=VALUE
  default: 2

server.debug
  environment: MEDIATED_MAILBOX_SERVER__DEBUG
  flag: --server.debug=VALUE
  default: false

server.banner
  environment: MEDIATED_MAILBOX_SERVER__BANNER
  flag: --server.banner=VALUE
  default: yes: no

server.routes.<key>.target
  environment: MEDIATED_MAILBOX_SERVER__ROUTES__<KEY>__TARGET
  flag: --server.routes.<key>.target=VALUE
  required

server.routes.<key>.weight
  environment: MEDIATED_MAILBOX_SERVER__ROUTES__<KEY>__WEIGHT
  flag: --server.routes.<key>.weight=VALUE

Defaults of keyed values
  scanner.triggers.de: [Code]
  scanner.triggers.en: [code]
